style_prefix: Humane retro-industrial science-fiction storybook illustration, precise ink linework under translucent gouache color, teal pool light against rust-orange work lamps, readable silhouettes and interfaces, tactile worn materials, cinematic composition, no text.

prompts.prompt: Long station hearing room split between turquoise dolphin pool and grated dry gallery by a low pressure wall; broad route board bridges both sides; tactile rail, sealed evidence drawer, clerk console, one dolphin and three humans.
Dryside clerk slides a violet-sealed witness slate through a stainless evidence drawer while a slate-gray bottlenose dolphin circles the parallel pool and a carrier captain watches a berth countdown.
Slate-gray bottlenose dolphin presses a low pool paddle; synchronized white route light, raised rail pins, sound bands, and three pressure ripples cross a worn wet-dry hearing chamber.
Silver-haired carrier captain in creased cobalt work coat gives a compressed route account across a low pool wall while a scarred bottlenose clerk watches from turquoise water.
Young curly-haired apprentice with yellow sash places both palms on a raised tactile rail, matching long and short pins to pressure waves crossing a dolphin's flank in the parallel pool.
Close stainless evidence drawer through a pool wall: violet-sealed slate and three glowing custody marks, scarred dolphin eye at wet inspection window, clerk's ink-stained fingers on dry side.
Six white ship lines bend around a silver debris cloud on a route board while raised rail pins and turquoise pressure ridges carry the same trace past dolphin clerk and three dryside participants.
Pivotal channel failure: route light bends and tactile pin rises while water stays flat around a startled bottlenose dolphin; one underwater emitter glows red; three human hands freeze mid-action.
Scarred slate-gray bottlenose dolphin strikes a rubber pause paddle; amber berth clock freezes; clerk watches carrier captain; apprentice keeps both palms on raised rail; failed emitter remains red.
Dryside clerk works timing blocks, apprentice follows tactile pins, dolphin aligns broadside to rebuilt pool ripples, carrier captain stands beneath a one-minute amber countdown.
Close pool view of scarred bottlenose dolphin broadside across surviving pressure ridges, reading water over jaw, flank, fin, and scar while an amber bracket marks a missing route interval overhead.
Carrier captain places duplicate slate on tactile rail and points to three timestamps; apprentice fingers stop at second mark; dolphin compares slate, rail, and route board across pool wall.
Symmetrical wet-dry hearing chamber at decision point: dolphin faces three low paddles; clerk at console, carrier and apprentice at rail; route board shows six ships and one failed channel gap.
White admit paddle glows beside dolphin clerk; food cases and clinic-filter canisters roll toward opening berth door; carrier exhales while apprentice keeps one hand on final tactile notation.
Amber-red reject paddle glows; carrier hull moves from berth toward standby beyond window; cargo waits behind pressure door; sealed evidence and failed trace remain inside hearing chamber.
Late-shift translation in wet-dry hearing room: clerk builds timing blocks, apprentice stays at tactile rail, dolphin receives replacement pool waves, carrier waits between rail and exit.
